queue.title: Written answer reviews
unavailable.title: Reviews are not available here
queue.intro.title: Evidence comes from the learner's words
queue.intro.body: Mark a criterion as met only when you can quote where the answer shows it. A clarification request records no judgement. Decisions are final for that answer and become independent evidence only when the item was answered without help.
queue.empty.title: Nothing waiting
queue.empty.body: New written answers appear here for review.
queue.draftRequested: AI draft requested for {learner}. It appears here once checked.
card.ownSubmission: This is your own answer. Another reviewer must review it.
card.reviewerAsked: Reviewer asked {probe, select, yes {(neutral question)} other {(with a hint)}}: <note>{note}</note>
criterion.quoteNotFound: Not found exactly in the answer.
criterion.useSelection: Use text selected in the answer
note.label: Message to the learner
note.probeOnly: My message is a neutral question with no hint (the learner's reply can still count as independent)
assist.notConsented: The learner has not allowed AI drafts for their written answers.
assist.failed: The AI draft could not be produced. Review the answer directly{again, select, yes { or ask again} other {}}.
assist.rejected.title: AI draft rejected
assist.rejected.body: Core's checks refused the model's draft: {reason, select, no_quotes {it marked a criterion as shown without quoting the learner's answer} quote_not_in_answer {it quoted words that are not in the learner's answer} criteria_mismatch {it did not give exactly one finding for each rubric criterion} output_too_large {it was too long} other {it did not pass the checks for this request}}. Nothing from it is shown. Review the answer directly{again, select, yes { or ask again} other {}}.
assist.request: Ask for an AI draft of the findings
assist.requestAgain: Ask again for an AI draft
assist.requested: {origin, select, supervisor {The supervisor is drafting findings for this conversation.} other {An AI draft was requested.}} Refresh to see it once it has been checked.
assist.noDraft: No usable AI draft for this answer. Review it directly.
assist.draft.title: AI draft — not a grade
assist.draft.body: {origin, select, supervisor {The supervisor proposed these findings when the learner submitted. } other {}}A model drafted them from the question, the rubric and the learner's turns in this conversation only. Its quotations appear in the learner's own words; whether they show each criterion is your judgement. Your saved review is what counts.
assist.check.title: Automatic check did not confirm
assist.check.body: This checkpoint's fixed check did not confirm the draft ({reason, select, evaluator_declined {it did not accept every quoted finding} proposal_not_met {the draft does not meet every required criterion} quotes_not_learner_words {a quotation is not the learner's own words} evaluator_failed {the check failed to run} evaluator_unavailable {the check is not installed on this server} grading_closed {the course policy does not allow grading now} not_ready {the answer or rubric changed} other {no confirmation}}), so the answer waits for your review.
assist.copied: Draft copied — check every finding before saving
assist.copy: Copy the draft into my findings
appeal.reason.title: The learner asks for another look
appeal.cannotDecide: You reviewed this answer (or wrote it). A different reviewer must give the second opinion.
appeal.decision: Your decision: {met, select, yes {Criteria met} other {Not yet}}{keeps, select, yes { (keeps the original)} other { (changes the original)}}
